bilingual_context: Bilingualism helps for national-scope roles but is less of a differentiator than in Ottawa; industry-specific skills matter more.
public_sector_context: Provincial government and municipal roles exist, but the private sector (finance, consulting, retail, tech) dominates student hiring.
b2b_tech_context: Toronto tech spans B2C and B2B, plus a large fintech sector — CRM, analytics, and campaign evidence transfer well.
positioning_advice: Toronto student hiring is high-volume and competitive — quantified, specific bullets matter even more than usual.
Financial services and Big 4 recruiting is structured and credential-aware — surface CPA-track coursework, case competitions, and finance club technical work explicitly.
Retail/CPG head offices value category, brand, and consumer-analytics language — translate campus marketing work into those terms where honest.

role_angles.advice: For a Toronto financial-services role, emphasize Excel/modeling evidence, finance coursework applied to real analyses, attention to detail, and any client-facing experience.
For a retail/CPG role, translate campus and part-time experience into consumer terms: shopper insights, promotions, category or sales data, and in-store operations.
